title: Faith: Visualization of, and Belief in Attainment of Desire
coreMove: Train faith by repeating a definite aim with feeling, then prove it through action, plan-seeking, and service before fear can rehearse defeat.

exampleSpecs.audience: founders trying to turn conviction into organized persuasion
exampleSpecs.stakes: A large idea will die as fantasy unless the founder can connect belief to a credible plan and capital path.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Show conviction becoming useful only when it organizes a plan, partners, and finance.

exampleSpecs.audience: workers rebuilding confidence without empty pep talk
exampleSpecs.stakes: A rejection pattern can become identity unless the applicant writes and rehearses a better script tied to action.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Use the self-confidence formula as practiced self-command instead of mood repair.

exampleSpecs.domain: neighborhood tenant organizing after a small turnout
exampleSpecs.audience: organizers who mistake low resources for low power
exampleSpecs.stakes: A small meeting can look like failure unless the organizer understands how disciplined belief grows social force.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Use Gandhi to show faith as organizing energy beyond money or office.

exampleSpecs.domain: small dental clinic after lost clients
exampleSpecs.audience: operators whose private language is shaping public behavior
exampleSpecs.stakes: A fear sentence repeated with emotion may change staff tone, client offers, and follow-up decisions.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Show negative self-suggestion training conduct as powerfully as positive rehearsal.

exampleSpecs.domain: nonprofit sponsorship letter before a board review
exampleSpecs.audience: leaders checking whether ambition has kept its moral guardrail
exampleSpecs.stakes: A confidence statement can become selfish persuasion unless it includes service and non-injury.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Use the formula's ethical promise as a hard check on desire.

exampleSpecs.domain: city council testimony for street safety
exampleSpecs.audience: residents turning private conviction into public action
exampleSpecs.stakes: A resident coalition may lose its nerve if belief stays private until the public moment has passed.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Frame faith as shared courage that moves into disciplined public conduct.
